t: The Prompt Becomes the Contract, and I Become the Agent
s: This article details a shift from conversational AI programming to a 'prompt-as-contract' model where humans act as general contractors and AI as subcontractors, emphasizing explicit instruction and error handling for robust AI development workflows.
sub: Prompt as contract for AI agents
Human as general contractor, AI as subcontractor
AI workflow with explicit instruction and error handling (Nix shell, sed, git)
Bridging human intent and machine precision with AI intermediaries
Local override of AI training data via hyper-specific contracts
